title: Access-Control-Max-Age is not a delta-seconds value
description: The Access-Control-Max-Age value is not a run of digits, so a browser ignores it and falls back to its own default preflight cache lifetime. The deployment's intention to cache the preflight for a chosen period is not honoured, and the observable configuration no longer matches the documented one.
remediation: Write Access-Control-Max-Age as decimal seconds. Keep the value within the range browsers accept and document the chosen period beside the allow-list.
limitation: One header value. The rule validates the token and does not predict the default a particular browser applies when the attribute is discarded.
